messages:
Asha (eng-platform): quick sync — we need to settle on the canonical field names we put on logs for trace linking. current mix of `trace_id`, `traceId`, `trace-id` is causing broken links in Console :grimacing:

Matt: agree, it's messy. i'd prefer sticking to OpenTelemetry conventions. OTEL logs spec uses `trace_id` and `span_id` attributes (snake_case). keeps parity with otel exporters and many collectors.

Jia: +1 for OTEL defaults. also want to call out W3C traceparent header — we need to normalize the incoming header into our log fields (32-hex trace id). browser SDKs sometimes send only 16-hex, need to pad or reject?

Riley: we should not silently mutate trace IDs. if we see 16-hex (64-bit), record it and add `trace_id_truncated:true` or store as-is but normalize representation when linking (prefer full 32-hex). otherwise hard to debug cross-service.

Matt: good point. proposal: store both raw header string in `http.traceparent` (or `traceparent`) and store normalized `trace_id` (32-hex) for indexing. normalization logic in collector: if 16-hex, left-pad with zeros and set `trace_raw_format: "64-bit"`.

Asha (eng-platform): sketch of fields to index for fast query: `trace_id`, `span_id`, `service.name`, `env`, `request_id`. Also `user_id_hash` (not raw user id). we should avoid indexing PII.

Jia: agreed on hashed user ids. also important: mark which fields are high-cardinality — `trace_id` should be indexed (keyword), but `user_id_hash` might be high-card but okay if hashed. we should explicitly NOT index freeform `message`.

Riley: for Console "jump to trace" links we need the trace id format expected by our trace backend. Jaeger/OTel Collector tracing UIs expect 32-char hex. confirm we always expose 32-char in link builder.

Matt: yep. link format: `/traces/{trace_id}`. also note some of our older services wrote `traceId` as 0x-prefixed hex. collector should strip `0x` when present.

TelemetryBot: [collector] config applied to prod: otlp-rewrite-trace-ids v1.2 — stripping 0x, padding 16-char -> 32-char, adding attributes `trace_id_normalized` and `trace_raw` :white_check_mark:

Asha (eng-platform): retention question — proposal: traces 30d, traces-indexed-links 90d (index for linking), logs 90d default, metrics 90d. thoughts? longer retention costs $$$.

Jia: 30d for full raw spans seems fine. we can keep an index-only store for `trace_id` and minimal attrs for 90d to support Console linking/search without full span data.

Riley: operationally we need an emergency SLA to keep traces for on-call investigations for 90d on-demand (hot storage -> cold archive). add a workflow for reviewers to request extended retention per trace id range.

Matt: implementation notes — collector pipeline:
- receive OTLP/logs + headers
- run normalization span processor
- add `trace_id` (normalized), `trace_raw`, `trace_raw_format`
- add `service.name`, `env` if missing from resource
- export to traces backend and into logs ingest (with index mappings)

Asha (eng-platform): UX/rollout plan: canary for 10% of traffic for 48h, then 50% for a day, then full. telemetry flag `telemetry.trace-normalization=v2` so we can revert.

Jia: tests we need before canary: cross-service roundtrip test (frontend -> backend -> worker) with 3 trace formats (32-hex, 16-hex, 0x-prefixed) and verify Console `Jump to Trace` resolves all to same trace.

Riley: also unit test for our query layer: ensure `trace_id` is stored as keyword, searchable, and that short ids don't collide. add e2e that builds dashboard panel linking to trace and opens trace viewer.

Matt: small snippet for Node Express middleware to attach normalized trace to logs:

```js
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const tp = req.headers['traceparent'] || '';
  const tid = normalize(tp); // pads/strips 0x
  req.trace_id = tid;
  logger = logger.child({ trace_id: tid });
  next();
});
```

Asha (eng-platform): one last privacy note: do not surface `user.email` in logs/index by default. if product wants it, must be explicit opt-in, documented, and sanitized.

TelemetryBot: canary rollout scheduled: 2027-05-02T09:00Z -> 2027-05-05T09:00Z, owner @Asha (eng-platform).

Matt: i'll open a PR with collector pipeline changes, mapping updates, and migration playbook. assigning to @Jia for infra PR review.

Jia: on it. i'll also add migration scripts for removing old `traceId` fields and backfilling normalized values where possible.

Riley: thanks all. this should make Console links much more reliable. :party_parrot:
